say:2:1321741001:1.text: The people of Whiteridge are truly devoted to their faith.
say:2:1321741001:1.source_cn: 白山公国的子民果然都是虔诚的信徒。

say:3:1321741002:1.text: Are you referring to this letter praying to Dura?
say:3:1321741002:1.source_cn: 你是说这封向艾雅祈求的信？

say:4:1321741003:1.text: It's clear that the <style="highlight">maid</style> who stayed by Amy's side mirrors Miss Lydia.
say:4:1321741003:1.source_cn: 看得出来，故事里一直陪伴艾米的<style=highl...

say:5:1321741004:1.text: Like the maid, Miss Lydia must have prayed countless times with unwavering faith, pleading for Dura's mercy to save Princess Yolena.
say:5:1321741004:1.source_cn: 恐怕她也和故事中的女仆一样，无数次虔诚地向艾雅祈祷，祈...

say:6:1321741005:1.text: ...That's right. Miss Lydia cared for Princess Yolena since her childhood. She was the closest person to the princess, other than the Archduke.
say:6:1321741005:1.source_cn: ……没错。莉娅女士陪伴公主殿下从小长大，感情深厚。除大...

say:7:1321741006:1.text: Because of that, even when others had accepted the inevitable, she continued to encourage the princess to hold on to hope.
say:7:1321741006:1.source_cn: 也正是因此，即使其他人都已丧失希望，她也一直在想办法鼓...

say:8:1321741007:1.text: Praying to Dura... was her last resort. Yet the goddess' mercy never reached the princess.
say:8:1321741007:1.source_cn: 向艾雅祈求……已经是最后的办法了。只是殿下没能等来女神...

say:9:1321741008:1.text: Perhaps I shouldn't say this, but... it may have been the princess' fate, something even Dura herself could not alter.
say:9:1321741008:1.source_cn: 或许我不该这么说，但……这可能就是亚莲娜公主的命运，艾...
